MR Safety
The Nova Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 3 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 1,000 Gauss/cm (10 T/m).
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Any receive-only coil may be used.
- Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.5 W/kg.
- No more than 20 minutes of active scan time per session.
The image artifact extends approximately 10 mm from the device.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
